Added Domain Model Generator in Maia to generate entities, attributes, and associations from business model descriptions.
Added support for XPath constraints on associated entities in the offline database.
Added option to define fallback page or microflow for web navigation profiles, with Path parameter support.
Added version control status icons to App Explorer on macOS.
Improved source selection for branch creation; top revision now selected by default.
Display Custom name from JSON Structure in Call a microflow dialog box.
Added alternative exposed name option for OData entities and microflows, supporting kebab-case and OpenAPI document usage.
Improved performance when typing in the expression editor.
Upgraded JDBC driver for Microsoft SQL Server to version 12.6.3; may require updating in userlib.
Now display warnings in addition to errors when Limit to current tab is selected.
Aligned microflow URL behavior in React client with Dojo client; hash removed after page load.

Upgraded react-native-device-info to version 11.1.0.
Upgraded react-native-fast-image to version 8.6.3.
Updated response for PUT requests to 405 for OData services.
Introduced new Java API to add necessary session cookies for non-client login scenarios.
Strict mode now analyzes pages with cancel action to ensure only editable widget entities are rolled back.
Merged React client and React native packages in Studio Pro; reduces files shipped; only mendix package in SBOM.
External Database Connector now supports using stored procedures with parameters.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro on Mac loaded user settings from previous version.
Fixed issue where cached session data was retained after new user login; now cleared on login.
Fixed exception when creating microflow for object handling with duplicate attribute names.
Fixed unnecessary vendorlib-sbom.json updates.
Fixed database synchronization error when setting entity with decimal attribute as generalization.

Fixed issue where Metrics.ApplicationTags was not used for some built-in metrics.
Fixed issue where corrupted repository or network issues presented analytic scope error.
Fixed issue where corrupted WSDL files gave no consistency error or error dialog.
Fixed issue where empty timeout expression gave error; now gives consistency error.
Fixed issue in published REST services showing error about unable to refresh grid.
Fixed issue where single underscore as enumeration element name caused app errors; now prevented by consistency error.
Fixed issue where some Maia suggestions could not be added to empty looped activities.
Fixed issue where useless flow left behind when deleting/detaching object in circular flow.
Fixed issue when updating consumed OData contract where readable entity becomes non-readable with deleted attributes.
Fixed issue where changing event action or list view on click/pull down action resulted in Oops dialog.
Fixed issue where userlib dependency name in SBOM was incorrect.

Fixed issue where workflow state set incorrectly to continue when containing failed activities.

Fixed error dialog displayed after opening app in Mendix Portal when signed in with no Internet.
Fixed memory leak in notification pop-ups such as running app notification.

CSS file line endings not handled properly; files appear in Changes on Disk dialog during Revert All Changes or version-control operations.
Mendix Solutions Kit released for GA with protected add-on modules and solution lifecycle management for adaptable solutions.
Machine Learning Kit released for general availability (GA).
Mendix Event Broker license now available for all customers.
MxAssist Performance Bot renamed to Best Practice Bot; will expand to include security and naming convention best practices.
Page URLs support multiple parameters, non-Id attributes, and variable segments at any URL location.
Aggregate list activity adds All, Any, and Reduce aggregation functions; all aggregations support expressions.
New Clear from device nanoflow activity clears entity objects from device database without server synchronization.
New Wait for notification workflow activity and Notify workflow microflow activity suspend/resume workflow execution.
Workflow multi-user tasks support parallel execution with Consensus, Veto, Majority, Threshold decision methods and Auto-assign/Who Can Open options.
Improved performance of editing published web service operations. Large data structures no longer cause Studio Pro to become unresponsive.
Input parameters can now be set as return variables via context menu.
Reduced cases where data source is reloaded even if container is hidden by conditional visibility.
Improved export size of model, now about half the size in many cases.
Improved data encryption in mobile apps.
Added support for signing in using macOS external browser. Requires configuration.
Added Version column to Open App dialog displaying Studio Pro application version.
Added Preferences link to Open App dialog box.
Added tooltips to Branch Line, Message, and On Disk columns in Branch Lines dialog.
Updated Revert All Changes menu item to show Open App dialog if app is closed after operation.
Extended Work Environment tab in Preferences with Studio Pro Theme auto-detection based on operating system color preferences.
Moved Rendering settings to Work Environment tab in Preferences.
New merge algorithm with fine-grained conflict resolution is now default and only option. Removed from Preferences New Features tab.
Design mode is now default page editor for new users. Does not affect existing installations.
New Properties pane from 9.23 is now default and only option in Studio Pro.
Renamed Data Hub pane to Integration pane. Still view available data sources and use them in app.
Added F1 help support to Machine Learning Kit document and fixed Properties pane issue.
Changed default location for published OData service to use lower-case.
Removed None button when selecting insert, update, or delete microflow for published OData resource.
Set variable name of Aggregate list activity to Count by default.
Changed empty enumeration value caption from (empty) to Empty in decision outcomes grid for workflows.
Enhanced Lock workflow and Unlock workflow microflow activities by enabling selection of workflow definition.
When creating new workflow, possible to select context entity through creation dialog.
Added button to workflow editor toolbar enabling export of workflow to image.
Added right-click option to convert between microflows and nanoflows in App Explorer.
Added Expose as action option to context menu of microflow editor for discoverability.
Added support for enumerations as attribute type for business events.
Pluggable widgets with system property Label now have Show label set to Yes by default.
Pluggable widgets with database, XPath, or association data source can select entity path from surrounding data widget.
Configuring pluggable widgets with association properties easier with default database source selection.
Extended MXP003 recommendation for non-indexed attribute in sorting to same attribute types as XPath.
Added new MXP016 recommendation to find OData source missing index key.
Updated MXP011 recommendation to group recommendations together by deeply nested views.
Added Category column to MxAssist Best Practice Bot pane.
Added button to filter MxAssist Best Practice Bot recommendations for uncommitted documents.
Updated MxAssist Logic Bot for Boolean decision with true and false flows created.
Cloning Git app branch makes local copy first, then downloads latest from server, speeding up branch operations.
When adding attribute, Studio Pro now considers existing attributes and types, auto-sets enumeration document.
Added new IDResolution log node providing details about actions on Mendix Runtime.
Removed limitation preventing automatic import/export mappings from message definitions with 100+ attributes.
Data sources for list view, data grid, template grid can select entity path from surrounding data widget.
Improved message for unsuitable parameter arguments, now includes expected parameter type.
Single XPath query no longer results in multiple SQL queries. Non-transaction XPath queries no longer run concurrently.
Added option to mx check command to output results to JSON file.
Improved naming generation in JSON structure.
In OQL, Attribute = $Parameter where parameter is collection containing only null now checks attribute is empty.
Added private market option to list of available target markets for Studio Pro.
Updated sign-in response pages to include new Mendix logo.
Updated login image shown on startup.
Included dark-mode support for login dialog shown on startup.
Updated style for Open App dialog, tab control, alert control, and selection in text fields.
Modernized New Document dialog and message definitions editor with dark mode support.
Updated style for context menus, toolbar controls, and button controls.
Updated style for UI components including breadcrumb, button, checkbox, date selector, dropdown, radio button, and others.
Updated colors in microflow editor, dialog boxes, and tree and grid controls.
Made drop-shadow style of various UI components more consistent.
Updated icons of message dialog boxes.
Tree and grid control rows now highlighted when hovering over them.
Added ability to select text in read-only drop-down controls.
Reduced number of default panes in default layout of Studio Pro.
Aligned horizontal indentation of text in column headers and cells in data grid and tree controls.
Made possible to use scrollbars in disabled grids.
Added IMxRuntimeRequest.getRootUrl method to Mendix Runtime API to retrieve root URL.
Added getSslContext to IHttpConfiguration interface in Mendix Runtime API for accessing SslContext.
Added default values for ProcessedTasksCleanupAge and ScheduledEventsCleanupAge: 365 days for existing apps, 7 days for new.
Introduced StrictChangeBehaviour setting enabled by default. Invalid enum or calculated attribute value now throws exception.
Dropped support for MariaDB 10.3 as it is no longer supported by the vendor.
All SVN support has been removed. Migrate to Git using provided documentation.
Removed deprecated methods from the Mendix Runtime API and the M2EE API.
Removed deprecated com.mendix.core.UseMimeDecoderForBase64 setting. Base64 decoding is now always strict per RFC 4648.
Removed deprecated rollbackTransAction() method from public IContext interface. Use rollbackTransaction instead.

affected: Import Web Service or XML Schema wizard
text: Deprecated Import Web Service or XML Schema wizard in domain model editor. Will be removed in Mendix 10.6.
Deprecated deploying directly to Cloud Foundry from Studio Pro. Functionality will be removed in Mendix 11.
Deprecated Counters, Gauges, Sets, and Timers interfaces from Mendix Runtime API. Will be removed in Mendix 11.
Increased default BCrypt cost factor from 10 to 12. Factor below 12 is deprecated and will be forbidden.
Deprecated publishing OData v3 in published OData services. Use OData v4 instead.
parseDateTime[UTC] microflow functions now use strict parsing by default. Set com.mendix.core.LenientDateTimeParsing to true to revert.
Order of Before Commit and After Commit events execution may have changed when committing multiple objects. Order is unspecified and should not be relied upon.
DOM structure changed: div[data-widget-wrapper] placed around React widgets in Dojo containers; script element removed. May affect CSS with child/sibling/nth-child selectors.
Updated icons in Atlas and widgets to new Atlas icon set (Atlas Core 3.11.0). New class names used in DOM; custom styling relying on glyph icon class names may need updates.
Removed deprecated reporting category widgets. Any existing reporting category widget now triggers a consistency error.
Removed deprecated direct function calls from Pluggable Widget API for linked property values.
Renamed WorkflowUserTask_Assignee association to WorkflowUserTask_Assignees; now a reference set to support multiple assignees.
Published OData Services now give consistency error when exposed name of attribute/association matches exposed entity name.
Validation of exposed names in published OData services now follows OData standard; 128 character maximum for OData v4 services.
No longer support DB2 as database for applications.
Upgraded SQL Server JDBC driver to version 12.2.0. Uses TLS encryption by default. Set DatabaseUseSsl to false or encrypt=false to disable.
XPath constraint [$objectVariable/BooleanAttribute] with unset microflow variable now treated as [false()] instead of being ignored.
In OQL, using path with association in ON clause of OUTER JOIN is no longer allowed.
In OQL, comparing attribute to collection parameter only allowed with IN or = operators (e.g., Attribute IN $param).
In OQL, clauses with infinite range (null to null) previously ignored now treated as true; changes OR behavior. null-bounded ranges no longer ignored.
Duplicate column names in OQL query no longer allowed.
No longer support custom reason phrases in HTTP responses. Removed IMxRuntimeResponse.setStatus(int, String); ReasonPhrase attribute now ignored.
Legacy scheduled events (non-repeating or with start time) no longer supported. Runtime fails to start if they exist.
Removed custom setting for Mendix Runtime uniqueness validation; database uniqueness validation is now mandatory.
Stricter URL format validation: no empty path segments (//), ambiguous segments (%2e%2e), or UTF-16 encoding (%u2192).
Upgraded com.sun.xml.ws.jaxws-ri from 2.3.6 to 4.0.1. SOAPFaultException now in jakarta.xml.ws namespace.
Removed deprecated metric types statsd and logger. Only micrometer supported. Removed legacy StatsD settings; use Metrics.Registries instead.
Removed request metric mx.runtime.stats.handler.requests.[name]; replaced with mx.runtime.stats.handler_requests with handler name as tag.
Cannot call clear() on list returned by IDataTable.getRows(). List from subList() is no longer modifiable.
IDataTable, IDataTableSchema, IDataColumnSchame no longer provide equality; equals() and hashCode() based on object identity.
Changed MIME type for *.js files from application/javascript to text/javascript.
Removed deprecated error constants from AdminException and IMxRuntime.
Removed deprecated IActionRegistrator#bundleComponentLoaded method.
Public constructors of generated constant and microflow proxy classes now private; classes marked final.
Entity and list of entity parameters in Java actions initialized in constructor; __[FieldName] field deprecated. Call getMendixObject() to access IMendixObject variant.
Methods initialize(IContext, IMendixIdentifier) and getGUID() no longer generated on entity proxies.

Introduced ObjectManagement.StrictChangeBehavior (enabled by default). Setting invalid enum/calculated attribute value throws InvalidEnumerationValueException or ReadOnlyAttributeException. Setting removed in Mendix 11.
Exception type when setting virtual method through setValue changed from CoreRuntimeException to ReadOnlyAttributeException.
Fields in Java actions now generated as final fields.
Linux package for MxBuild no longer contains mxbuild.exe. Use mxbuild instead to execute MxBuild on Linux.
Workflow migration conflict detection for multi-user tasks is too rigid; incompatible tasks cannot continue in certain decision method changes.
The Visible for property in Navigation section of Properties pane for pages is visible but non-functional; cannot select module roles.
Merging a branch into another branch with identical commits creates unnecessary additional commits automatically.
Line endings in CSS files not handled properly; files appear in Changes on Disk during version-control operations.
Added logging for objects/attributes found in XML/JSON payload but not mapped in Import mapping document.
Added support for SOAP arrays in Import mapping documents with any name, not just 'item'.
Added validation for return variable name in End Event Properties dialog to prevent invalid names.
Added support for SQL queries with column names containing spaces and special characters.
Removed consistency error when association data source had steps traversing from local to external entity.
Added setting to enable Windows Authentication for a private Git server.
Fixed issue in Call REST action where file document request body resulted in HTTP request without Content-Length header.

Implemented IMendixObjectMember.getOriginalValue for database binary members enabling rollback.
Added option to add extra arguments to Gradle process in Studio Pro Preferences.
Added extra-gradle-arguments option to MxBuild for passing arguments to Gradle process.
Prevent packages from unpacking content to undesired directories when importing modules or widgets.
Authentication token is now rotated ensuring new token generated upon session expiration.
Added error logging when page fails to load in React client due to corrupted widget bundle.

Fixed disabling Multiple sessions per user incorrectly killing all sessions and deleting valid tokens.
Fixed Substract, Union, Intersect list operations not always returning unique values in nanoflow.
Fixed association from entity to own specialization being set in opposite direction on update.
Fixed urlEncode and urlDecode functions in client to align with runtime; spaces now encoded as %20.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro closed after user logged in.
Fixed database synchronization failing with Key not found error after renaming entity with unique rule.
Fixed keyboard shortcuts not processed correctly in Expression editor.
Fixed way multiline text is displayed in Enumerations document.
Fixed Select App and Open App dialogs displaying local changes instead of Mendix portal names.
Fixed Studio Pro closing when adding SVG file to Image Collection document.
Fixed error displayed in Consumed REST Service after pressing Send for specific requests with empty content.
Fixed unexpected exception in domain model editor showing dialog instead of closing Studio Pro.
Fixed exception while checking consistency of external attributes, associations, and enumerations.
Fixed enumeration captions not returning caption in default language when requested language unavailable.
Fixed date format preview in Studio Pro to be consistent with runtime and client formatting behaviour.
Updated date formatting in client for genitive and abbreviated month names consistency with runtime.
Importing module containing workflows makes all running workflow instances incompatible.

Generated BOM-refs for managed dependencies in the SBOM.
Improved performance of published OData services using Read microflow by querying per association instead of per object.
Disallow creating variable names that clash with predefined variables like $CurrentUser in logic editors.
Fixed issue where saving changes in message definition within Structure's search field did not show selected elements.
Fixed issue where Chrome incorrectly displayed PWA installation prompt for non-PWA apps.
Fixed issue where after translating widgets, some translations were reset during widget update prompts.
Fixed issue where retrieving external entity with non-sortable key attribute resulted in error.
Fixed issue where task validation at startup marked pending tasks with microflow arguments as incompatible.
Fixed issue where structure mode went blank after changes or showed Oops pop-up with no undo context error.
Fixed external entities with unlimited string key; apps upgrading to 10.12.11+ now start without column length changes.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro crashed when working with the clipboard.
Fixed issue where bottom bar disappeared with nanoflow-based homepages using clear history.
Fixed issue where Maia recommendation was not placed correctly in microflow editor.
Fixed default tab attribute with page parameter causing deployment error; selector no longer allows direct page variable selection.
Fixed default tab attribute validation; now correctly checked and produces consistency error if applicable.
Fixed issue where default tab attribute number larger than tab count resulted in rendering error.
Fixed issue where closing beta Mapping editor showed an error.

Fixed issue with pull operation when setting up PMP configuration.

Fixed JavaScript actions for web and native platforms failing to bundle in React client.

React client debugger does not reconnect when restarting app.
Added non-interrupting timer boundary events as beta feature for user tasks, Call Microflow, Call Workflow, and Wait for Notification.
X-Ray mode is now generally available for Windows and macOS to visualize page structure with special borders around widgets.
Added Project Context option to Help > Support Tools showing Studio Pro background memory information.
Added Background option to Help > Support Tools showing current and previous background task information.
Added Collect version control data option to Help > Support Tools to collect version control data from logs.
Added Profiling > Capture Memory Snapshot option to Help > Support Tools to capture Studio Pro memory usage snapshots.
Improved error messages for connection errors when an action or data source is triggered.
Improved performance of the auto-completion pop-up window in the expression editor.
Objects returned in Call External Action are now uniquely identified using their remote key for associating local objects to external objects.
Upgraded bundled Node.js version from v16 to v20.
Now throw a consistency error when a page or microflow without any roles has a URL configured.
Default values are now supported for action properties in pluggable widgets with defaultType and defaultValue.
Can now use expressions for conditional visibility and dynamic classes without surrounding data container for top-level variables.
Overview Pages Generation dialog box now allows overwriting previously generated folders.
It is now possible to create Studio Pro memory snapshots.
Optimized the performance of the Properties pane when editing pages, enhancing responsiveness.
In case of foreign key constraint violation during commit, ForeignKeyConstraintViolationException is now thrown with uniform error message.
Added support for MariaDB 11.4.
Added support for MySQL 8.4.
Added hyperlinks for collecting feedback on published-GraphQL services via survey.
Now clean up anonymous users after a REST call finishes.
Commit dialog box now always displays all tabs with change counts and default focus on tab with changes.
Updated system to store log files for up to 30 days, compared to previous duration of seven days.
Added support for keyboard navigation in App Explorer on macOS and modernized App Explorer on Windows.
Added keyboard support of Ctrl/Command + mouse scroll wheel to zoom in or out in the workflow editor.
Upgraded JDBC driver for Microsoft SQL Server to version 12.8.1. May need update in userlib for integrated security.
Added support for hard-coded strings containing JSON as a parameter value in Query External Database activity.
Added Ctrl + Enter keyboard shortcut for OK in Query External Database dialog box.
Updated Oracle Library to 23.5.1 to fix TAF mode of FAILOVER_TYPE=SELECT if configured on Oracle DB.
Added scroll to the parameters section of Query External Database.
Now support updating existing entities with new and/or deleted columns.
When creating a new query, you can now reuse existing entities mapped to other queries of the same database connection.
Added connector identification as Mendix-ExtDbconnector_SP-#Version_MPK_#Version for Snowflake connections.
Introduced the Untyped Model Access feature to Extensibility API for C# API access.
Fixed data validation errors triggered on rollback or delete. Manually generated validation errors now removed when objects rolled back or deleted.
Fixed issue where roles assigned to user were ignored momentarily during runtime.
Fixed garbage collector cleaning up objects being returned from microflow before return, leading to error.
Fixed Mozilla Firefox change event triggered before input validations complete.
Fixed querying OData entity filtered by associated entity attribute with self-referencing many-to-one association.
Fixed native app stuck starting repeatedly when authentication token invalid. Clear authentication and session cookie when no longer valid.
Fixed Studio Pro crash when using Shift+Enter in Expression editor.
Fixed Core.initializeSession blocked by database transaction lock in SQL Server with foreign keys enabled.
Fixed build failure when app with jar exclusions created in Studio Pro 9.24.0 or below opened in newer version.
Fixed issue preventing Native Bottom Bar styles from being applied.
Fixed Oops dialog when opening Edit Datasource for Data grid 2 after editing expression like Option caption.
Fixed Oops dialog when generated column filter in Data grid 2 moved to another column.
Fixed Data grid 2 automatic content generation when setting reference data source for filtering over associations.
Fixed Oops dialog switching template parameter from attribute to expression if attribute no longer exists in domain model.
Fixed conditionally hidden text template property showing in Changes pane when other widget properties changed.
Fixed extension cache clean-up issue in Studio Pro causing problems with extensions.
Fixed Mac custom value not persisted switching XPath Builder to Expression Editor or pressing OK.
Fixed spreadsheet import with dollar sign in data preventing local application run.
Fixed published OData services editor error attempting to show published microflow when none selected.
Fixed consumed web services WSDL error on network drive requiring authentication without WWW-Authenticate header.
Fixed logic editors visual bug where annotation on first loop element broke displayed variable types.
Fixed Retrieve over association not showing correct data type with entity generalization.
Fixed logic editors highlighting of parameter objects when selected.
Disabled text selection in places users would not want.
Now correctly account for excluded jars of managed dependencies when compiling Java actions.
Fixed LibGit2 not fetching extra objects while in partial mode.
Fixed access rule icons not clearly visible in dark mode in new editor.
Dropped support for MariaDB 10.4 as vendor no longer supports it.
Starting version 10.17, PostgreSQL 12 support dropped as vendor announced end of support.
Boundary events scheduled when workflow activity started. For user tasks, scheduling occurs before targeting microflow finishes.
When failed activity with boundary events retried, only first level boundary events aborted/restarted, not nested ones.
Workflow jumping back into activity with scheduled timer boundary event schedules another event incorrectly.
Finished parallel split path removed from running workflow instance wrongly leads to versioning conflict.
Line endings in CSS files not handled properly, appearing in Changes on Disk during version-control operations.
Added progress pop-up window when renaming, including or excluding a document/module in the App Explorer.
Made the Commit dialog box faster and more responsive.
Fixed Windows-specific issue where temporary files created for images upload were not cleaned up.
Introduced consistency error when data source was entity path with steps traversing from local to external entity.
Improved memory usage of Dojo client by fixing memory leaks when opening thousands of pages.
Fixed Oops pop-up when opening View on Your device dialog with navigation profiles of same kind.
Fixed issue where apps using Dojo client broke due to browser extensions injecting scripts.
Fixed error in XPath constraint processing causing System.ArgumentException: QueryConstraint not found exception.
Fixed displayed output variable name for Import with a mapping action in logic editors.
Fixed issue where list view item actions were not working correctly in native client.
Fixed issue where index creation failed when one attribute was not available on offline database.
Fixed multiple tasks scheduled for same scheduled event by cleaning up superfluous tasks on startup with extra logging.
Fixed deployment failure when entity had one system association already in database and second one added later.
Fixed issue where incorrect homepage was briefly displayed before configured nanoflow action homepage finished loading.
Fixed extracting microflows to correctly create parameters when variables were used in loops.
Fixed bug where variable names were translated causing error messages to be shown.
Reverted fix for listening between widgets to continue after hiding selecting widget with conditional visibility.
Importing module containing workflows makes all running workflow instances incompatible.
In React client, re-running app locally with runtime-only changes does not properly apply those changes.
In React client, debugger does not reconnect when restarting app.
Consumed REST Service document released for general availability on Windows, enabling faster REST integration with automatic response-to-entity conversion.
Localized Studio Pro interface (beta) added in Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and German via Work environment preferences tab.
Optional parameters for microflows and nanoflows with empty argument expressions and default values; parameter mapping updates now optional.
Native Template 10 introduced for native apps in 10.17+, enabling newer React features with breaking changes requiring migration.
Iterator index variable $currentIndex added to loops in nanoflows and microflows.
Modernized System Text editor now enabled by default; opt-out available in Studio Pro settings.
New Headers tab in App Configurations for local development header configuration, including pre-defined Content-Security-Policy header.
Support for mx.parser added to React Client API.
Runtime can now start automatically from configuration file without M2EE commands; multi-node setups require identical configuration.
New CLI command for viewing unit size statistics in apps via MPR Analyze Command.
Custom runtime setting DataStorage.OptimizeSecurityColumns added to optimize SQL columns for XPath constraints in entity access rules.
Workflow modeling improved: remaining activities automatically moved to parent flow when activity final outcome deleted.
Boundary event addition streamlined by removing event type selector for faster, easier user experience.
Microflow settings for Execution, Confirmation, and Advanced sections aligned across widgets (data container, button, etc.).
Mendix Blog and Mendix Medium posts added as data sources for Maia Chat.
Maia Domain Model Generator now returns dynamic responses for meaningful follow-up conversations during domain model generation.
Studio Pro log level can now be changed via Help Menu > Support Tools.
Simplified version of operation execution dialog available via Help Menu > Support Tools.
Memory consumption optimized when using Refresh button in Stories and closing app after App Settings dialog.
.NET Runtime version updated to 8.0.10.
Consistency error improved for published OData and REST service location checking against runtime URL prefix configuration.
OpenTelemetry Micrometer registry support added to send metrics via OpenTelemetry protocol using opentelemetry registry type.
New Preferences setting Generate Full Debug Info allows including full debug information when compiling Java actions.
Call Home licensing improved: any node can report to license server; com.mendix.core.isClusterSlave setting no longer determines sole reporter.
Git process command line interface logging added to improve traceability and debugging of version control activities.
New icon in History dialog marks revisions where MPR format differs from previous revision.
Code syntax highlighting improved in certain editors, especially in dark mode.
Fixed known issue where versioning conflict was raised if finished parallel workflow path was removed.
Fixed microflow list variable unusable after Delete Object(s) activity. Setting Microflows.RemoveVariableOnDeleteObjectsActivity to true restores old behavior, removed in Mendix 11.
Removed changing condition values on flows through Logic Recommender.
Fixed exception (Oops pop-up) when unknown variable used in microflow expression editor.
Fixed issue where images synchronization took considerable amount of time.
