Fixed bug where wrong type name was returned for Custom Blob documents during rename event payload.
Made Event sub-process start activity in workflow not draggable.
Made main start activity in Workflow not draggable to prevent accidental drags and data loss.
Studio Pro now ships with JDK 25 and Gradle 9.5.1. Java 25 requires Gradle 9.1 and above.
Apps can now be configured to use Java 25 in App Settings.
Preferences now allows configuring a different JDK for each supported Java version.
Apps targeting Java 25 can now use language constructs and APIs introduced with Java 25.
Newly created apps are now configured to use Java 25 by default.
Maia now supports working with Change Data Capture documents.
Maia can now answer questions about version control history and commit and push changes.
Versioned deployment packages are now prefixed with branch name: {BranchName}-{AppName}_{Version}.mda.
Module ID can now be passed to element selector for selectedElementId property to preselect module.
Clear from device nanoflow action now removes specific objects from offline device storage.
Users can now create a branch directly from a specific commit via History pane right-click menu.
History pane toolbar now has Branch line filter to view commit history without switching branches.
Added ability to filter out on-disk changes on the Comparison pane.
Package manifest now indicates module type and whether it contains extensions or AI skills.
mx show-module-version and set-module-version commands now work for all modules, not just protected ones.
mx module-import command now supports updating and replacing existing modules.
Find Results pane now stores multiple searches as tabs instead of using separate Find Results 2 pane.
Improved build performance and reduced memory usage of React client when bundling with Rspack.
ListOperation activity now uses ICU4J library instead of Java Collator for consistent sorting in microflows and nanoflows.
Items in Comparison pane are now sorted by default, first by module then by document type.
Studio Pro now deletes log files older than seven days.
Added support for MariaDB 12.3 and MySQL 9.7.
Logic editors now draw sequence flow arrows in an improved way.
Maia now enforces best practices more strictly in logic editors.
Maia Chat messages now have context menu item to open links in default browser.
Maia Skills pane filter toggle now uses clearer label 'Show errors only' and more appropriate icons.
Maia Agent visual design updated to align with EU AI Act compliance guidelines.
Users can now use Enter key to navigate between Maia questions and submit answers.
JSON Structure document editor now opens in a tab instead of a dialog.
Runtime now omits values of Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization, Set-Cookie, X-Auth-Token headers in HTTP logging.
Added BiConsumer overloads to ListenersRegistry, ActionListener, EventActionInfo for event listener callbacks with IContext.
Consumer<IMendixObject> methods in ListenersRegistry and ActionListener are deprecated, will be removed in Mendix 12.
Java Migration Tool upgraded to 1.0.2 with recipe for deprecated ActionListener and ListenersRegistry methods.
Rspack updated to version 2.1, reducing bundle times by up to 25%.
React client bundling diagnostics improved with clearer reporting for memory-related bundler failures.
Reduced exported bundle size for React and Native clients by translating only text parts that differ between languages.
Extensions Overview UI improved to be more modern and consistent with Studio Pro.
Module ID can be passed to element selector for selectedElementId to preselect and expand module.
Fixed error in offline-first (PWA) apps on iOS 26.5.2+ where synchronizing newly added image/file documents failed due to missing contents.
Fixed issue in React client mode where snippets did not load properly when navigating to a page with the same snippet.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro did not update Java proxies during deployment after renaming a module.
Fixed issue where attribute references in microflow expressions were not updated when the attribute was renamed in domain model.
Fixed error in offline-first (PWA) apps when list view with association data source was opened for unsynchronized context object.
Fixed issue where editable condition set to Never was lost during widget conversion.
Fixed issue with External Database Connector where editor crashes when entity attribute type changes from String to Enumeration.
Fixed issue on Windows where pressing Ctrl+F in CSS or JavaScript editor opened global Find dialog instead of editor's built-in search.
Fixed issue where JavaScript actions with npm dependencies in actions/node_modules folder failed to bundle in React client for Rollup and Rspack bundlers.
Fixed issue with External Database Connector where query results displayed incorrect BIGINT values in editor.
Fixed issue where text box values filled in by password manager were not registered.
Fixed issue where expanding a folder in document selector showed it as expanded but without its contents.
Fixed issue where attributes used in expression were not found when deleting attribute from domain model or calling Find Usages.
Fixed issue where opening Git preferences threw error when Studio Pro could not load Git configuration. Now shows clear message explaining resolution.
Fixed issue where activities in microflows generated by Maia showed default caption Activity instead of describing activity.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro incorrectly went into offline mode at startup due to transient SSL connection failure when fetching OpenID configuration.
Fixed issue where Maia did not create sufficient spacing before and after loops within microflows.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro froze while progress dialog was shown, for example while opening an app.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro froze for up to several seconds during copy operations when another process held lock on clipboard.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro incorrectly displayed consistency errors after opening an app.
Fixed issue where active document's tab got scrolled out of view after opening many documents in a row.
Fixed issue where renaming a module or entity led to consistency errors in microflow expressions.
Fixed issue where Maia named single objects returned from Retrieve Action as {entity}List.
Fixed custom icon visibility for exposed microflow, Java and JavaScript actions based on icon availability and selected Studio Pro theme.
Fixed issue where in-editor Logic Recommender dialog appeared for empty microflows, nanoflows, and rules after disabling Recommender in Preferences > AI.
Fixed issue where content of microflow editor and domain model editor (Beta) canvas appeared blurry after scrolling or zooming.
Fixed issue with External Database Connector where users could not expand column widths in result set preview.
Fixed issue where Push your changes notification bar was incorrectly shown after merge or cherry-pick producing no actual model changes.
Fixed issue where some grid cells in Studio Pro became empty while scrolling the grid.
Fixed issue where concurrent Git operations failed with Index is locked error when status bar polled for conflict information during write operations.
Resolved issue where using Undo All in Changes pane did not remove overview pages generated by Start with Maia.
Fixed Maia's inability to create While loops.
Fixed issue in MCP settings pane where Enable all and Disable all buttons remained clickable even when all tools were already in that state.
Removed theme.compiled.css.map from deployment package due to privacy and security concerns.
Fixed issue where date filters sent to OData services with DateTimeOffset attributes contained wrong date format, causing rejection.
Fixed issue where publishing microflow in new REST service allowed adding that service to read-only modules such as System module.
Fixed issue where opening non-version-controlled app after version-controlled one showed old comparison data in Comparison pane.
Fixed issue where Studio Pro appeared frozen when marking/unmarking module as UI resources module. Progress dialog now shown during synchronization.
Fixed issue in modernized App Explorer where Studio Pro appeared unresponsive after moving documents or folders. Progress dialog now shown.
Fixed issue in modernized Find Results pane where closed result sets reappeared and displayed number of open result sets was incorrect.
Fixed issue in modernized App Explorer where actions triggered with keyboard shortcuts were applied to previously selected node.
Fixed issue where pressing Escape to close modal dialog also closed the sidebar.
Fixed issue in microflow editor where sometimes loop was selected when trying to select elements inside the loop.
Temporarily removed functionality allowing update modules retaining customizations (introduced in 11.12.3) due to known issue with GUIDs.
Deprecated support for Java 21. Support will be removed in Mendix 12. Mendix recommends using Java 25.

Deprecated Consumer<IMendixObject> overloads of ListenersRegistry.register*Listener, ActionListener.addBeforeEvent/addAfterEvent, and EventActionInfo constructors. Use BiConsumer<IContext, IMendixObject> instead.
Requests to servlets registered via Core.addDevelopmentServlet now require authentication. M2EE admin password must be provided in X-M2EE-Authentication header (Base64-encoded).
Maia Chat pane may appear and remain functional even when Maia is disabled in Edit > Preferences. Workaround: Manually close the panel.
Switching back to Mendix Platform provider and saving configuration with BYO LLM causes reasoning and caching to stop. Workaround: Click New Chat to restore.
Skills button in Maia Chat not visible after adding skills via Maia. Becomes visible only after restart, closing project, or starting new chat.
mx.exe module-import replace and update commands will not rescue storage GUIDs after module update, resulting in data loss.
Introduced Send Email microflow activity (beta) to send emails directly from microflows with server configuration, authentication, recipients, and attachments.
Added Location setting to Module Settings General tab to choose regular module list or Marketplace modules node display.
Added ability to update modules from files via right-click in App Explorer. Supports merge algorithm and conflict resolution for *.mpk* files from 11.12.0+.
Added support for constants in OQL queries using $<Module>.<Constant> syntax in Java API.
Added support for enumerations in OQL queries using <Module>.<Enumeration>#<Value> syntax in Java API.
German is now available as a beta language in Studio Pro Preferences dialog.
Added Copy Path button to notification when app folder fails to be excluded by antivirus.
OqlStatement Java API now supports INSERT INTO VALUES statements to insert value rows directly.
Maia now supports working with JSON Structure documents.

Added observability for offline synchronization with success/failure counters, System.SynchronizationHistory entity, and com.mendix.offline.SynchronizationHistoryRetentionDuration setting (default: 365 days).
Added ability to display added documents and elements details in Comparison pane.
Added ability to display deleted documents and elements details in Comparison pane.
Added new setting to enable or disable OQL generation with Maia. OQL generation always uses Mendix Platform regardless of provider.
Added Maia Explain and Solve problem with Maia Chat context menu options to Error List for understanding and resolving consistency errors.
Studio Pro now automatically selects a free port for MCP server when default port is in use, allowing multiple instances to run side by side.
Notification shown when MCP server starts with active port visible in status bar.

affected: workflow Timer Event Sub-Process Start Event
text: Added support for interrupting and non-interrupting behavior on Timer Event Sub-Process Start Event to interrupt or run in parallel with parent workflow.
External Database Connector is now built into Studio Pro. No longer need to download from Marketplace.
Web extensions must now include @mendix/model-access-registry in external build configuration.
Improved performance logging infrastructure by integrating OpenTelemetry tracing for correlated diagnostics and profiling.
Improved Studio Pro initialization time by 20-30% on macOS and 10-20% on Windows.
Made local deployment faster by improving performance of microflows model export.
Improved security of module import process. Fixed bypass in extraction-time path filter where non-canonical ZIP entry names could evade protected-subtree check (CVE-2025-40592).
Added multi-selection support for Modernized Find Results table.
Now close app selector before Open App progress dialog when Studio Pro main window is shown.
Updated icons in Microflow Editor to vector icons for crisper look on high-resolution screens.
Maia now receives detailed information about errors inside microflow expressions for more accurate corrections.
Improved editor for consumed OData services using toggles instead of checkboxes with separate header group. Toggle available to revert to old behavior.
Now support MENDIX_TRACING_FILTER, MENDIX_TRACING_MAX_LOOP_ITERATION, MENDIX_TRACING_MAX_MICROFLOW_DEPTH environment variables in addition to system properties.
Improved cursor tracking performance of modernized app explorer's drag preview.
Embedded applications now support optional parameters for home page and home microflow.
Fixed NPE parameter passing to server actions failing with 'Object hash is invalid!' after transparent session restore. Read-only hash key now preserved via auth token.
Fixed React client mode widgets in snippets becoming unresponsive after navigating between pages using the same snippet.
Resolved mxbuild failing when compiling a project on macOS.
SQL Server now uses IF EXISTS when dropping unique or foreign key constraints to avoid automatic rollback if constraint does not exist.
Fixed runtime failing to finish executing a queued task started by a user if the user is deleted during task execution.
Fixed files with '%' in filename unable to be downloaded, causing incorrect 'file could not be found' errors.
Fixed extracting submicroflow from activities with predefined variables creating reserved parameter names. Predefined variables now skipped during parameter generation.
Fixed application build error: 'System.FormatException: The input string '' was not in a correct format'.
Fixed app failing to bundle with Rspack enabled when pluggable widget used certain Mendix modules like mendix/parser and mendix/session.
Resolved Java files not being generated in Studio Pro when deploying for Eclipse.
Fixed PWAs using Rspack where service worker would sometimes not be created correctly.
Fixed Microflow Editor clearing selection not updating Properties pane, keeping previously selected element instead of microflow properties.
Fixed spurious type error on return value of end event when microflow's return type set to Nothing.
Fixed History pane losing commit details for unsynced local commits after background Git refresh.
Removed GuidMapping documents from the Changes pane.
Fixed beta version of import/export mappings where arrow keys to move between entities did not keep selection in view. Now keeps selected entity centered.
Consolidated three workflow versioning conflict types into single ConcurrentPathRemoved conflict for clearer, more consistent messaging on concurrent path removal.
Resolved issue where importing Marketplace modules in Studio Pro on macOS sometimes did not include Java actions correctly.
Changed consistency check for offline Create/Change actions with AutoNumber or Calculated attributes from hard error to warning. AutoNumber defaults to 0; Calculated attributes not evaluated offline.
Resolved Studio Pro hanging on 'Updating original app' step when opening a project.
Fixed Change Data Capture service allowing addition of inherited attributes and associations, which is not supported.
Fixed Change Data Capture AsyncAPI schemas missing 'id' field in generated entity definitions.

Removed unusable parts due to previous deprecations: Reporting widgets (deprecated since Mx 10), DataSetAccess (UI non-functional, rules not respected), DataSet Object parameter constraint (not respected by runtime).
Resolved double-toggle issues in Debugger Variables Pane when pressing left/right arrow keys followed by Enter key press.
Fixed 'Undo all' after deleting file modified or created by Maia causing error.
Fixed renaming a document not updating its name in the Maia changes list.
Fixed 'Undo All' on multiple files created by Maia showing unexpected error dialog in apps with online services enabled.
Fixed orientation issue in datepicker widget for iOS, now supporting landscape orientation.
Fixed beta version of export mapping editor where collapsing entity did not show '…' indicator for hidden child elements.
Resolved Document tabs not being visible in Studio Pro on macOS after opening an app.
Resolved dialogs not appearing centered on top of existing window or dialog in Studio Pro on macOS.
Fixed Title widget to update its displayed text when navigating between pages in a native app.
Fixed local file storage not using optimal directory structure.
Fixed Extensions setting visible for all module types instead of only for add-ons.
Fixed Studio Pro appearing to freeze briefly when opening an app. Progress dialog now covers full loading process.
Fixed deleting or reverting file on disk while open in editor recreating it as empty file. Editor tab now closes when backing file missing; saving refreshes explorer.
Fixed downloading Marketplace module with Maia displaying module name in version field.
Fixed Mendix Marketplace MCP server connection repeatedly disconnecting and reconnecting every few seconds.
Fixed MCP connections briefly disconnecting and reconnecting right after Studio Pro startup.
Fixed requests to MCP servers identifying with generic browser user agent instead of Studio Pro.

affected: No user is signed in error
text: Fixed Studio Pro showing 'No user is signed in' error while using MCP server requiring Mendix Platform sign-in while signed out.
Fixed modernized app explorer drag preview not consistently showing disabled indicator for invalid drop point.
Fixed auto-scroll on macOS for the modernized app explorer.
Fixed folder expand-on-hover during drag in the modernized app explorer.
Fixed modernized app explorer clearing selection when dragging document to different module. Moved document now stays selected; explorer regains focus.
Find results tags now show matching document type icon and cleaner label for easier distinction at glance.
Fixed modernized app explorer allowing too many nodes to be selected at once.
Fixed position of find results in View top menu, now appears in correct alphabetical order.
Fixed issue when calling mx.ui.openForm in the Dojo client.
Missing progress message on blocking progress bar no longer causes crash during deployment.
Fixed call web service and OData version 3 services. XML parser now rejects DTD declarations and external entities to prevent server exploitation.

affected: t is not a function crash
text: Fixed 't is not a function' crash in Microflow and Workflow editors, introduced by recent Microsoft WebView update.
Support dropped for PostgreSQL 13, no longer supported by vendor.
Support dropped for MariaDB 10.6, no longer supported by vendor.
Maia Chat pane may appear and remain functional even when Maia is disabled in Preferences. Workaround: manually close the panel.
Switching from BYO LLM to Mendix Platform provider causes reasoning and caching to stop. Workaround: click New Chat to restore.
Skills button in Maia Chat not visible after adding skills via Maia. Workaround: click New Chat to make it appear.
Added support for XPath constraints in nanoflow database retrieves to follow associations from a variable.
Added strict mode support for offline apps. Switching strict mode on may break existing apps calling retrieve_by_xpath in full synchronization.
Introduced Mendix Portable Runtime (Beta) for packaging applications as self-contained zip files with all dependencies.
Introduced opt-in runtime setting MaxRetrieveAmount that limits maximum objects retrieved by database datasource operation.
Clean up pending MendixRuntime-UpdateScheduledEvent and MendixRuntime-DeleteScheduledEvent system tasks before synchronizing scheduled events.
Improved resizing behavior of object list grids when editing pluggable widget properties in Studio Pro.
Updated .NET runtime version installed with Studio Pro to .NET 10.0.3.
No longer create ProcessedTask entries for MendixRuntime-UpdateScheduledEvent and MendixRuntime-DeleteScheduledEvent system tasks.
Changed log level of SystemTask log node to debug to reduce excessive messages in non-development deployments.
Changed popup initial rendering in React client; popups unavailable to UI testing frameworks until ready.
Fixed issue where tasks scheduled from microflow would execute before microflow ends; should execute after completion.
Fixed issue with data sources where non-committed specialization objects with associations caused system administrator error popup.
Fixed issue where select all for Data grid 2 over multiple pages did not work correctly with view entity.
Fixed issue where rerunning app threw error when browser session storage quota exceeded; now logs and reloads without state.
Fixed error in Offline Retrieve Action when entity is not accessible to current user.
Fixed issue where changing queue parallelism through microflow constant was not working correctly for cluster-wide queues.
Fixed issue in offline apps database retrievals with constraints returning empty results when constraint referred to generalization association.
Fixed issue with strict mode when using rollback/commit action on page while using entity on layout.
Fixed issue where Mendix app would crash if hoisted in directory with node_modules containing conflicting package versions.
Fixed incorrect runtime warning for missing parameters during database retrieval with XPath constraint when parameters were omitted.
Fixed issue where snippet variable was not available in expressions for conditional visibility and editability.
Fixed issue where OQL with UNION of more than two NULL and non-NULL expressions could fail in PostgreSQL.
Fixed issue in offline apps where database retrievals using reverse associations returned empty or incorrect results.
Fixed issue where snippet variables were not working properly in conditional settings in snippets.
Ensured all columns in UNION branches have name or alias to avoid database compatibility issues like SQL Server.
Fixed Workflow Commons module URL to correctly respect MarketplaceUrlP configuration variable.
Fixed issue where automatic update of conditional settings was not triggered with invalid local variables.
Added consistency error for invalid conditional settings at top-level widgets.
Fixed issue where access denied exceptions could occur during rebase, merge, cherry-pick, revert, or feature branch merge.
Fixed issue where reversing association direction via context menu did not function correctly in Domain Model editor.
Fixed issue with bundling protected modules in App Modules not including JavaScript actions and dependencies.
Fixed issue where queued task that became incompatible was not removed and remained stuck in Running status.
Fixed issue where synchronization caused scheduled event to be executed multiple times.
Fixed issue where popups sometimes appeared at bottom of screen instead of being centered.
Fixed race condition where focus was unexpectedly removed during page load; autofocus now waits for all widgets.
Fixed issue where deleting duplicate navigation profile would sometimes delete wrong duplicate profile.
Fixed Oops popup when copying button widgets with parameter arguments to page templates or building blocks.
Invalid SQL generated by task queue subsystem on Oracle database causes application startup to fail.
Error 't is not a function' in logic editors from Microsoft Edge WebView 2 version 150 prevents editing.
Each module now has stable Module ID for unique identification. Version field available for all module types. Marketplace manual version changes no longer possible for modules exported from 11.12.0+.
Studio Pro automatically assigns Module ID to existing modules and generates SHA-256 Checksum. Module ID and checksum stored in manifest.json alongside package.xml.
Change Data Capture (beta) introduced. Publish Mendix domain model entity changes as Kafka events. Works with Event Broker, BYOK, and Event Broker Bridges for external routing.
Option to purchase Maia Units introduced for additional Maia Make capacity.
Modernized Variables pane now preserves expanded nodes while stepping through debugger.
Offline synchronization now throws PartialSynchronizationError when server rejects objects, catchable in try/catch blocks.
Toggling web fetch tool in Maia preferences now takes effect immediately without Studio Pro relaunch.
User can see current Studio Pro version through Preferences API.
documentAdded event added to IProjectChangesApi allowing extensions to react when new document added.
Ability to filter Comparison pane by change status (added, modified, deleted, moved). Filters persisted across sessions.
Sortable columns added to Comparison pane Documents and Elements views for easier finding and grouping.
New DATEFORMAT function implemented in OQL.
Two new OQL functions implemented: RPAD and LPAD for string padding operations.
Maia can now work with theming and styling, modifying variables, creating custom styling, managing design properties.
Maia can now ask clarifying questions before proceeding, supporting open-ended, single choice, and multiple choice answers.
Embedded Client released in public Beta for embedding Mendix apps into host applications.
permissionsChanged event added to Extension Permissions API for permission state change notifications.
Custom instructions now addable at project or module level. Project-level added to every Maia conversation.
Maia now thinks before responding with visible real-time reasoning display, revisitable throughout conversation.
MCP OAuth authentication now uses dedicated callback server on fixed port range 44380–44384.
MCP connections now support Mendix Identity (MxId3) authentication with automatic platform access token.
Maia Agent Instructions introduced as context automatically added at project or module level.
New Skills pane shows loaded custom skills, status, and module. Can filter by errors and sync immediately.
Custom skills now addable to non-protected app modules and exported with module contents.
Maia now shows which custom skill or resource it uses while working for better transparency.
Custom LLM provider configuration released in public beta. Supports OpenAI-compatible and AWS Bedrock per-project.
Maia improved at fetching and understanding web page content by focusing on main content.
Markdown files (*.md, *.mdx) up to 50 KB each can be attached to Maia chat messages as context.
Maia Agent session can be saved via Help > Support Tools > Capture Maia Agent Session.
Data Transformers now generally available for transforming complex JSON. Maia support added for creation and modification.
Reduced time to open an app in Studio Pro.
Reduced time for Studio Pro and MxBuild to check app for consistency errors.
Fixed memory leaks causing increased memory consumption over time when using App Explorer.
Improved performance of Page Editor, Workflow Editor, Microflow Editor and Domain Model Editor.
Progressive web app (PWA) wrappers now in GA, allowing packaging PWAs as native apps for app store distribution.
History pane now shows author name instead of email; email visible by hovering.
Added forRemoval and since attributes to public Java API deprecated annotations.
Improved Studio Pro performance for App Explorer operations like right-click and double-click.
Updated .NET Runtime to version 10.0.7.
Added confirmation dialog when enabling anonymous user access, warning about data exposure risk.
Microflow and entity parameters can now be optional for Java actions.
Renamed Tracing tab to OpenTelemetry in Studio Pro configurations.
Added option to enable logs sent via OpenTelemetry in OpenTelemetry configuration.
OpenTelemetry endpoint now used for both traces and logs; should not end in "/v1/traces"; auto-updated during migration.
Maia can now use system member properties of entities.
Reorganized AI preferences into separate tabs for Maia and MCP Server settings.
Improved REST service editor; form parameters cannot be List, option no longer shown.
Find Advanced now displays widgets grouped by platform type and ordered by name.
Modernized JavaScript Action Editor now enabled by default; revert via Preferences > New Features > Use legacy JavaScript Action editor.
Improved cleanup of queued tasks owned by missing nodes.
Improved observability for retrieve operations; XPath constraints, entity paths, object types, microflow names now in span names.
Runtime nodes automatically shut down when heartbeat updates fail or node database entry missing; improves cluster reliability.
Studio Pro will now always overwrite files from vendorlib directory when importing modules.
Comparison pane toolbar shows compared revision hashes as clickable links for version-controlled apps.
Added com.mendix.metrics.Metric.Builder.withTags(Map<String,String>) method to public Java API.
Compare two revisions directly from History Pane by selecting commits and using Compare submenu.
Significantly enhanced performance of history pane for faster, smoother experience.
Browser can now cache app bundle parts, fonts, and app icons for faster subsequent loads.
Gradle daemons automatically stop when exiting Studio Pro, preventing unnecessary background processes.
Can now change event type for boundary events in Workflows via context menu.
Added document type icons to modernized Debugger pane for easier type identification.
addBlankPage now requires layout and page name; added addWidgetsToPageRoot for easier widget addition.
Domain Model Editor now shows recommendations.
Fixed arbitrary code execution vulnerability in Studio Pro (CVSS 5.4).
React client now copies files from pluggable widget's assets subdirectory into widget's dist/ directory during bundling.
Fixed Generate pages dialog not being scrollable.
Fixed issue where passing empty string as parameter to on change microflow triggered error.
Fixed OData service not showing consistency error when changing association type/owner, now prevents metadata changes without notification.
Fixed native app crash on startup when user role lacked access to module entity in offline sync profile. Now returns no objects.
Fixed Oops pop-up when microflow/nanoflow return value mapping referred to attribute outside data view.
Fixed Studio Pro crash when pasting while another application accessed clipboard.
Fixed race condition where widget value setter executed on destroyed value store, causing ListView page crashes.
Added row range selection shortcut in modernized Console using Shift+click.
Permission state now persists when replacing module containing extension with permissions.
Added small delay between retries of saving conflicting project files to prevent race conditions.
Fixed constants from protected modules not exported when creating portable app deployment package via MxBuild.
Fixed switching schema source in import & export mapping leaving previous elements visible alongside new ones.
Fixed potential freeze of Studio Pro when error dialog shown on startup.
Fixed Portable App Package export failure due to file copy operations outside default file-system scope.
Fixed alignment of breakpoints in Breakpoints pane and row height changes when toggling breakpoint.
Fixed copying attributes from view entities creating non-editable attributes in persistent entities. Existing affected attributes now auto-fixed.
Fixed Maia accidentally generating broken Call REST Service and Call Web Service actions in microflow.
Fixed Toolbox categories with same caption appearing as duplicate sections on refresh.
Fixed DELETE OQL statement with table alias causing database exception.
Fixed visual bug where Call a nanoflow action properties displayed settings from different property based on configuration order.
Fixed Maia Explain triggering new chat session instead of continuing in active session.
Fixed Native App Builder failure when project and Studio Pro on different drive locations.
Fixed crash when launching Native App Builder UI second time while previous instance still being tracked.
Fixed Studio Pro showing security consistency error when return value mapping referred to attribute outside direct enclosing data view.
When calling external OData service action, additional attributes for optional parameters now correctly sent even without value.
Fixed published REST service editor showing parameters with unknown type as Boolean.
Added detailed troubleshooting option in module settings (enabled by default) for add-on/solution modules to show descriptive consistency errors instead of CE1707.
Fixed History pane unexpectedly crashing.
Fixed OAuth metadata discovery failing with CORS errors when connecting to MCP servers requiring proxied requests.
MCP tool names now sanitized and truncated to comply with LLM provider requirements, preventing connection errors.
Fixed documents and folders not movable into Marketplace modules in modernized App Explorer.
Fixed context menu opening at cursor position instead of selected item when pressing Shift+F10 in modernized App Explorer.
Fixed App Explorer not receiving focus after creating new folder.
Fixed tabbing into modernized App Explorer tree starting keyboard navigation from previously focused node instead of active document node.
View entities can no longer be copied via modernized App Explorer. Copy actions through menu, keyboard shortcut, or context menu now disabled.
Fixed startup failure in leaderless cluster on SQL Server database without Read Committed Snapshot Isolation enabled.
Fixed node labels wrapping and expand/collapse icon growing too large when resizing modernized App Explorer panel.
Fixed issue when using Rollup bundler with React client.
Fixed renaming user causing authtoken to become invalid.
Fixed rare race condition related to authtokens.
Fixed "Stopping debugging session..." progress dialog appearing when stopping debugging while not connected to runtime.
Fixed runtime error when View Entities query was open during app startup.
Removed elements helper methods (add*(), get*(), getContainer(), delete()) from model api types.
Studio Pro on macOS now runs natively on Apple Silicon (arm64). Intel-based Macs no longer supported.
Maia Chat pane appears and remains functional even when Maia is disabled in Edit > Preferences.
Switching from BYO LLM back to Mendix Platform provider causes reasoning and caching to stop functioning.
Skills button in Maia Chat is not visible after adding skills via Maia until restart, project close, or new chat.
Omitting optional parameter from parameters object in embedded navigation profile shows fallback page instead of default value.
Error 't is not a function' from Microsoft Edge WebView 2 version 150 prevents creating microflows, nanoflows, rules and opening Logic Recommender.
Wrong build distributed for version 11.6.0 between December 23, 2025 and January 6, 2026. Re-download to get correct build.
Extensibility APIs menus redesigned: commandId property and menuItemActivated event removed, action property added and invoked directly on click.
Modernized web runtime console now available via preference in New Features tab.
Pluggable widgets now support prompt element to enhance definitions for Maia development assistance.
Call external action microflow activity open type parameters now support collection of primitive values attributes.
Non-blocking searchable History pane now GA for full clones. Preference to keep old History window. Mendix version added to Details. Copy values support added.
Group targeting for workflow user tasks released for GA. Create workflow groups, assign tasks to groups. Access updates automatically when membership changes.
Multiple workflow endpoints now supported. End workflows through multiple end events instead of single endpoint. Jump activities can be final elements.
Pages now support primitive parameters (String, Boolean, etc.). Optional parameters with default value expressions can be defined without updating all usages.
Improved scheduling of cluster node management actions.
Experimental Java API OqlStatement now supports INSERT INTO SELECT statements to create new objects.
Extra validations added for OQL UPDATE statements.
Support added for PostgreSQL 18 and Microsoft SQL Server 2025.
Improved error message handling: removed Broken Pipe errors, reduced exception wrapping, clearer top-level error causes. UseOldExceptionBehavior setting available for previous behavior.
Decimal scale now configurable at app level (8-18 inclusive), previously fixed at 8. Precision equals scale plus 20. May require data migration.
Micrometer gauges initialization timing changed to after database connection initialization, removing 'Failed to apply value function' warning.
Expired sessions now cleaned up in batches instead of all at once.
Aligned order of Use React Client setting options with other settings.
Timer behavior improved to handle null or empty expressions by skipping wait instead of throwing exception. Standalone timer moves to Finished state; boundary event timer marked Aborted.
Upgraded to React 19 and React Native 0.78 for enhanced rendering performance, improved native module integration, and modern foundation.
Fixed slow serialization of Mendix objects in microflow responses when entity access was not applied during retrieval.
Fixed error in Studio Pro installer checking if .NET version is already installed.
Fixed issue blocking pull, merge feature branch, revert, and cherry pick operations with broken commit metadata.
Fixed issue where creating new branch from tag was not working.
Fixed issue where unsaved changes in System Text editor would be committed when running app locally.
Fixed issue preventing some users from authenticating in Studio Pro.
Fixed OQL query parsing failure when query included numeric WHEN clause without accompanying ELSE condition.
Fixed issue where generating tailored homepage failed with Start with Maia.
Fixed performance issue in logic editors while running project with many microflows locally.
Fixed issue where System.UserRole's Description attribute is not readable when it should be.
SQLite files now included in service worker's pre-cache list to ensure offline availability.
Fixed issue where previously selected elements deep in tree structure were no longer selected after reopening.
Fixed Studio Pro crash when Select Elements functionality used with recursive XML structures.
OQL function DATEPART with MILLISECOND now works on HSQLDB and SAP HANA.
Fixed OQL data modification statement failure on MariaDB 10.x or MySQL with 'Table mendixsystem$temporary_ids already exists'.
Fixed issue where Enter press on leaf node did not open document.
Fixed issue where microflow names omitted from context menu in Go to microflow option.
Fixed bug causing exceptions when undoing custom widget addition from recommender, Maia or ctrl+drag and drop.
Fixed error when typing invalid values in zoom combo box on page editor in structure mode.
Fixed issue where wrong response schema generated with Export Mapping for OpenAPI v3.
Fixed issue where scheduled events with On overlap set to Delay next caused excessive 'Skipping the update' log messages.
Fixed Core.getLicenseInformation().products() not returning numeric value if larger than 2147483647.
Fixed issue where invalid sessions without associated user were never removed from database.
Now parse StdOut and StdError streams separately when calling Git process to improve stability.
Added timeout handling for history panel with 3 retries to get history from Git.
Now only log 404 errors in development mode to reduce log noise in production environments.
Fixed Esc key not closing modal pane when autofocus disabled in Dojo and React clients.
Fixed bug where File Uploader was not clickable when nested in container.
Upgraded AWS S3 library from version 1 to 2 with stricter configuration and AES-only client-side encryption support.
Added consistency check for code actions with filename not matching document name casing to prevent cloud deployment issues.
Error 't is not a function' in multiple logic editors due to Microsoft Edge WebView 2 version 150, preventing document creation and development.
When clearing history navigating from page without to page with bottom bar, bottom bar does not display.
Studio Pro now requires .NET 10 instead of .NET 8 as a prerequisite for running the application.
Reduced overhead on autocommitted object administration for REST calls.
Improved performance of runtime statistics collection.
Introduced new log node named SystemTask for logging system management actions.
Extended FeedbackHelper.addOpenFormFeedback Java API to allow opening pages with primitive and optional parameters.
Improved performance of documents operations (add, rename, delete, and more) in the App Explorer.
Added support for inline and block commenting in OQL using -- for single-line and /* */ for multi-line comments with nesting.
OQL INSERT INTO statement can now insert associations.
Improved location of generated entities when consuming an external action in Studio Pro.
Improved performance of Best Practice Recommender; it now runs faster and uses less memory.
Added batching to session keep-alive and last action execution update maintenance tasks with configurable batch sizes.
Improved handling of cases where a user is deleted while a session is concurrently retrieved for that same user.

Removed offline limitations for pages in offline-based navigation: entity constraints, list view templates, grids with search, multi-step paths, specialization pages, numeric search fields, online sync widgets, delete actions, data sources, Constrained by.
No longer allowed to instantiate entities with AutoNumber or calculated attributes in pages/nanoflows using offline-based navigation profiles due to value determination issues.
Enabled File manager component for offline PWAs and added file uploading and downloading features to offline PWAs.
mx.ui.downloadFile, mx.data.getFileUrl, and getFileUrl in mx-api/data module are now asynchronous.
tcpjsonlines log subscriber now supports tags and tracing information with configurable trace/span ID attributes.
Improved session cleanup performance.
Added keyboard accelerators to Find Usages and Show Call Hierarchy options in context menus.
Increased Studio Pro internal timeouts for front end web content from 10 to 30 seconds to reduce initialization errors.
Fixed issue where last attributes were cut-off in entity properties dialog.
Fixed Unused Items feature falsely reporting enumerations as unused when their values were used in microflow expressions.
Fixed converting microflow to nanoflow incorrectly preserving Execute on task queue setting on microflow call actions.
Fixed issue where Content attribute of $latestHttpResponse variable was empty when SOAP fault occurred.
Fixed slow typing in Dataset document causing delays in displaying each character.
Fixed issue in logic editors when extracted microflow lacked all parameters for newly created activity.
Fixed consumed OData services with external enumeration values that are reserved words like Int prepending underscores when applying filters.
Fixed issue where write permissions could not be removed for attributes converted to read-only types like AutoNumber.
Fixed tab container widget resetting to first tab when returning to page, causing unnecessary data source reloads.
Fixed sorting by column not working after using text search on a grid.
Fixed import mapping not reading JSON attribute values when preceded by attribute with prefix name, e.g. StatusId and Status.
Fixed List operation (Range) causing runtime error when Offset or Amount left blank.
Fixed Studio Pro crash when importing font for icon Collection.
Fixed incorrectly configured placeholder text not showing consistency error, preventing deployment errors.
Fixed macOS issue where text got highlighted automatically and overwritten by subsequent characters while typing in search field.
Fixed notify workflow activity to always update wait-for-notification activity even when workflow failed, paused, or incompatible.
Fixed setting lists of objects through generate dialog incorrectly showing error in change object dialog.
Fixed system texts not being updated in application during local development hot reloading without full server restart.
Fixed security issue where passwords could be modified through synchronize_objects API with write access to password attribute.
Fixed excluded modules being included in main.scss when generating layered CSS.
Fixed widget configured with incorrect type of primitive parameter not showing consistency error, causing client errors.
Fixed pressing Enter on leaf node in modernized app explorer not opening document.
Fixed double-click in modernized Runtime console not selecting row.
Fixed columns not being sortable in modernized Runtime console.
Fixed Select active document button not scrolling to already selected document in modernized App Explorer.
Fixed issue where not closing push notification bar during rebase/cherry-pick could result in two visible notification bars for new combination operation.
Fixed domain model generation and overview pages creation in Start with Maia failing when no entities generated by Maia.
Fixed Oracle OQL database exception when using ORDER BY with unlimited string in subquery.
Fixed Oracle OQL expression casting OQL parameter of type datetime to string raising database exception.
Fixed pasting view entity with associated persistent entity causing freeze and Oops pop-up window.
Fixed React client offline apps executing home page data sources too early, causing errors due to uninitialized offline system.
Fixed remote entities with decimal primary keys causing startup errors on existing deployments.
Fixed LIKE operator in HSQLDB OQL being case-sensitive when used in combination with OQL functions.
Fixed Oops pop-up window displayed when Edit > Find returned new JSON structure documents.
Fixed Import/Export mapping in Studio Pro omitting all child array elements in JSON except first.
Fixed consumed REST services in Studio Pro causing Oops pop-up window when sending request to URL with invalid characters.
Fixed domain model on Mac allowing addition of unsupported association to external entity.
Fixed dialog to edit Call external action microflow activity appearing to flicker on Mac.
Fixed dialog for choosing external associations showing purple external entity when resulting entity was non-persistable.
Fixed Call external action microflow activity showing consistency errors about parameter and return type after dragging from toolbox.
Fixed OpenTelemetry log subscriber correctly setting log node name as node attribute and exception cause as cause attribute.
Fixed calling get_license_information while using SALT license causing error.
Fixed interruption while fetching data causing model changes not displaying properly in new history pane.
Fixed refresh of commit statuses after Push (Local > Synced) and Pull (On Server > Synced).
Fixed bug in logic editors that caused Maia Explain for Microflows to crash.
Fixed new attributes of type unlimited string or datetime with default values having those defaults set incorrectly on existing objects.
Curly braces in placeholder text (e.g. {Name}) must now be escaped with extra opening brace (e.g. {{Name}) to prevent placeholder expression interpretation.
Creating new microflow, nanoflow or rule fails with t is not a function error in Edge WebView 2 version 150.
Opening Logic Recommender fails with t is not a function error in Edge WebView 2 version 150; closing and reopening clears it.
Unified Maia Make capabilities consolidate AI-assisted development into single chat for data structures, pages, microflows.
Generate microflows including XPath constraints, expressions, and more from natural language descriptions.
Connect to compatible MCP Servers to leverage tools such as Playwright or Figma.
Select existing story and let Maia help you realize it.
Added Cancel synchronization nanoflow activity to stop synchronization.
Added reloadApp function to mx-api/ui Client API with optional withState parameter to preserve application state.
Added non-interrupting event sub-processes to workflow editor for optional process flows at any point.
Added allowUpload flag on file and image properties with EditableFileValue and EditableImageValue types for PWA uploads.
OQL Statements are now Generally Available.
Introduced opt-in runtime setting MaxRetrieveAmount to limit maximum objects retrieved by database datasource.
Fixed OData Exists queries where XPath constraint with nested-associations resulted in incorrect OData filter.
Improved reloadApp function to handle sessionStorage quota exceeded errors with ReloadStateQuotaExceededError.
OQL DELETE FROM statement now supports associations with on delete behavior for cascading or conditional deletes.
Removed unnecessary transaction savepoints created by runtime when committing or deleting multiple objects.
Added configurable Use new string behavior option controlling null and undefined handling for string attributes in client.
Date Picker now shows placeholder or date format even in read-only state for consistency with other input widgets.
Progress dialog with single step now only shows progress bar without step indicator.
Improved performance for mx.exe diff command with reduced memory consumption and faster execution.
macOS installer now includes Mendix Version Selector for opening apps from Portal and using Start from Maia.
Studio Pro on macOS was renamed to Mendix Studio Pro.
Improved error message when database lacks pre-analysis migration version from Mendix versions earlier than 5.10.
Removed redundant Maia Explain button from logic editors; use context menu in App Explorer instead.
Simplified Maia preferences by adding single toggle to enable or disable all Maia features at once.
OpenAPI documentation pane in Studio Pro now allows copying text using Ctrl+C.
Improved Gradle settings in Preferences; Gradle location no longer hidden if synchronization is disabled.
Clarified error message when cloning or checking out branch into directory with long path.
Increased width of scrollbars on editors and panes to improve usability.
Improved Set all toggle in entity access rules editor to disable all rights when some lack access.
Consumed REST service editor in Studio Pro now available in all supported languages, not just English.
Improved security of Git process execution during version control operations.
Hebrew language code changed from iw_IL (deprecated) to he_IL (current ISO 639 standard).
Indonesian language code changed from in_ID (deprecated) to id_ID (current ISO 639 standard).
Fixed issue where Studio Pro could not find git after fresh installation from installer.
Fixed issue where document deleted in one source could not be resolved by deletion during merge.
Fixed Oops dialog with conditional editability when page contains multiple widgets with same name.
Fixed Oops dialog with conditional editability when widget referenced a default variable.
Fixed Oops pop-up when widget data source contained expressions referring to unavailable variables.
Fixed offline app error 'SQLiteError: table mx10414574138294561$_guidToTable has no column named inaccessibleAttrs' by ensuring proper database migrations.
Fixed NullPointerException when session token was generated but user name changed simultaneously.
Fixed Show Message activity having empty caption after initial microflow loading in logic editors.
Fixed incorrect credentials throwing client console error instead of validation message. Runtime now returns 401 for authentication failures and 402 for license errors.
Fixed setting building block image showing error dialog instead of resizing the image.
Fixed extracting submicroflow where sequence flow had invalid condition, resulting in missing condition in extracted microflow.
Fixed long-running after startup microflow causing other nodes to assume node had crashed.
Fixed widget MPK file corruption when downloading from Marketplace or updating via widget updater, causing Studio Pro error.
Fixed deleting external object with local association using direct association storage format failing with exception.
Fixed reversing association direction via context menu in Domain Model editor not functioning correctly.
Fixed workflow user tasks where no fallback outcome in majority or threshold criteria with single outcome prevented runtime start.
Fixed modernized app explorer where Del key in search input triggered document deletion instead of text deletion.
Fixed modernized app explorer not showing version number of add-on module.
Fixed modernized App Explorer not displaying visibility icon when export level set to 'Usable'.
Fixed modernized App Explorer where Escape key did not clear search query.
Fixed modernized App Explorer where Shift+F10 hotkey for context menu did not work.
Fixed modernized App Explorer where Domain Model node with View Entity children automatically expanded on double click.
Fixed macOS hotkey combinations displaying incorrectly in several right-click context menus.
Fixed SQLite Error 5: 'database is locked' error.
Fixed access denied exceptions during rebase, merge, cherry-pick, revert, or feature branch merge operations.
Fixed Maia explain for Microflows crashing sometimes.
Fixed Maia chat crashing when Studio Pro version attribute was missing in a reference.
Fixed Android scenarios where navigating Dataview fields of different types was impossible using external keyboard.
Fixed Call external action activity where resolving inconsistencies would clear additional attributes.
Fixed OpenAPI documents of published REST services using incorrect date values in examples.
Fixed com.mendix.systemwideinterfaces.core.IUser::getUserName always returning user name at login time instead of actual current name.
Fixed partially cloned apps mistakenly identified as fully cloned during cloning process, potentially causing 128 error.
Fixed macOS views behaving in unwanted ways when scrolling.
Fixed React client where autofocus on popup containing focusable elements only in header or footer resulted in no focus.
Fixed autofocus not enabled for login dialogs and popups shown by Show message action.
Fixed TabContainer not updating active tab attribute or firing onChange nanoflow on tab switch when passed as nanoflow argument.
Fixed Oops pop-up when page actions with return value mappings were copied, pasted or extracted to snippet.
Error 't is not a function' in logic editors due to Microsoft Edge WebView 2 version 150 when creating microflow/nanoflow/rule or opening Logic Recommender.
Maia now supports generating, editing, or explaining workflows, enumerations, constants, and modules.
Maia now supports Java actions (read-only, usable in microflows) and JavaScript actions (read-only, explanation only).
Maia now supports creating or refining view entities using plain language, generating OQL automatically.
Maia can now generate custom pages from scratch or modify existing ones, supporting local variables, data sources, client actions, XPath constraints, and expressions.
Maia can now generate cross-module references.
Maia can now read the System module and marketplace modules for explanation and context addition.
Maia can now remove elements from documents, enabling complex refactoring.
Maia can now rename elements inside documents such as entities, attributes, and microflow parameters.
You can now undo changes generated by Maia on a per-document basis.
Maia can now set annotation texts in the logic editors.
Added Mendix Portable Runtime (Beta) for deployments, packaging applications as self-contained ZIP files with all dependencies and configurations.
Rspack (Beta) is now supported as a new bundler for React client applications, delivering faster bundling and lower memory usage. Select via App Settings > Runtime.
New OQL functions added: DATEADD, DATETRUNC, LOCATE, SUBSTRING. Available via Java API or OQL module, not yet in Studio Pro.
Added support for strict mode in offline apps (PWA and Native Mobile). Note: switching strict mode on may break existing apps using retrieve_by_xpath in full synchronization.
Added Find Usages support for Wait for notification activities and Event sub-process start events to identify targeting Notify Workflow activities.
Introduced AI agent task element for workflows, now available in the workflow editor toolbox.
Workflow event sub-processes are now generally available.
New Web Extensibility API for accessing runtime functionality: studioPro.runtime.controller allows executing preview actions and monitoring runtime connection status.
New Web Extensibility API for accessing constants from active runtime configuration: studioPro.runtime.configuration.
Added permissions to access private constants from active runtime configuration via Web Extensibility, managed through extension overview pane.
You can now compare a historical revision to the current state from the Comparison pane, showing detailed changes.
Studio Pro uninstall now removes residual files. On macOS, use Mendix Version Selector (v58+) for this feature.
Live preview actions from Studio Pro now call servlets registered using Core.addDevelopmentServlet.
Added Core.addDevelopmentServlet method to register HttpServlet instances accessible via admin port during local Studio Pro runs.
Added nanoflow setting to align list parameter behavior with microflows. Existing nanoflows show deprecation warning: Switch to the new behavior to align with microflows.
Added option to use primitive page parameters in page URLs using the same syntax as microflow URLs.
Released modernized JavaScript Action Editor in public beta. Enable under Preferences > New features.
Added support for XPath constraints in nanoflow database retrieves to follow associations from variables.
Added client API skipWaiting from mx-api/pwa to activate waiting service worker for application updates.
Web Extensions can now raise consistency errors in MxBuild. Deno introduced to MxBuild tool chain.
Widget Marketplace metadata now stored in shared widgets-appstore-metadata.json file instead of individual *.mpk files. Module version strings corrected automatically.
Improved performance for repeatable container widgets with input widgets when not using React client.
Clean up pending MendixRuntime-UpdateScheduledEvent and MendixRuntime-DeleteScheduledEvent system tasks before synchronizing scheduled events.
Improved performance of opening the Entity selector dialog.
Improved Maia stability with fewer bugs and better overall performance.
Improved quality and reliability of Maia-generated workflows.
Decision outcome generation from enumerations is now more robust and reliable.
Improved user interface of the task list for the Maia generation cycle.
Added right-click context menu option to extract a layout grid row to a new one.
Removed unnecessary transaction save points created by runtime when executing microflow commit and delete actions with default error handling.
Upgraded JDBC driver for Microsoft SQL Server to version 13.4.0. Integrated security users may need to update userlib JDBC driver.
Prevent committing objects while synchronized to prevent losing committed changes in offline apps.
Improved resizing behavior of object list grids when editing pluggable widget properties in Studio Pro.
Improved visual feedback when modernized app explorer loses focus.
Improved log level styling to better distinguish between error and critical log levels.
Updated .NET runtime version installed with Studio Pro to .NET 10.0.3.
Removed reconnect and re-login buttons from MCP Settings.
Enabled debug-level message log under Rest Consume when user-specified Content-Length header is ignored.
No longer create ProcessedTask entries for MendixRuntime-UpdateScheduledEvent and MendixRuntime-DeleteScheduledEvent system tasks.
Changed SystemTask log node messages to debug level. Non-development deployments previously set to info, causing excessive messages.
Changed how popups are initially rendered in React client. Not available to UI testing frameworks until actually ready.
Improved performance when Studio Pro exports pages and layouts for React client during deployment.
Fixed tasks scheduled from microflow executing before microflow ends. Tasks should execute after microflow completes.
Fixed issue with non-committed specialization objects with associations causing system administrator error popup.
Fixed Oops dialog when Studio Pro encounters incorrect mx_metadata data. Users can now manage branches despite errors.
Fixed select all for Data grid 2 over multiple pages not working correctly with view entity configuration.
Fixed strict mode issue when using rollback/commit action on page while using entity on layout.
Fixed error in Offline Retrieve Action when entity is not accessible to current user.
Fixed issue where changing queue parallelism through microflow constant did not work for cluster-wide queues.
Fixed database retrievals with constraints in offline apps causing empty results when constraint referred to association on generalization.
Fixed Mendix app crash when hoisted in directory with node_modules containing conflicting package versions.
Fixed incorrect runtime warning for missing parameters in database retrieval with XPath constraint when omitted as empty.
Fixed snippet variable not available in expressions for conditional visibility and editability.
Fixed OQL UNION with more than two NULL and non-NULL expressions failing in PostgreSQL.
Fixed offline apps database retrievals using reverse associations returning empty or incorrect results.
Fixed snippet variables not working properly in conditional settings in snippets.
Ensured all UNION columns in OQL have name or alias to avoid issues with databases requiring them like SQL Server.
Fixed images not rendering when offline application opened in browser for first time.
Fixed issue preventing Security Overview export from opening.
Fixed activity records created with different activity keys. Original key now used in all subsequent records for same activity.
Removed WorkflowActivityRecord_PreviousActivity association which returned empty values. Use PreviousActivityKey attribute instead.
Fixed Workflow Commons module URL to correctly respect MarketplaceUrlP configuration variable.
Fixed modeler failing to trigger consistency error when workflow contains multiple start events in single process or sub-process.
Fixed automatic update of conditional settings not triggered correctly with invalid local variables.
Added consistency error for invalid conditional settings at top-level widgets.
Fixed Start from Spreadsheet incorrectly converting long type columns to Boolean on import.
Fixed Modernized Console not displayed automatically after starting Mendix app.
Fixed scrolling not happening automatically at bottom of table in modernized Runtime Console.
Fixed Ctrl+Alt+H (Windows) or Command+Option+H (Mac) not opening Call Hierarchy panel in App Explorer.
Fixed multi-select with Shift key not working correctly in modernized app explorer in certain cases.
Fixed commit notes and metadata empty after rebase with no MPR changes and no git conflicts detected.
Fixed Tab key inserting '\t' character into text inputs in multiline text area on macOS.
Fixed error message shown when copying and pasting folder in App Explorer in Studio Pro.
Fixed Maia sometimes creating sequence flows to parameters or annotations in logic editors.
Fixed Maia unable to generate mandatory empty outcome value for Decision and Object Type Decision.
Fixed Maia unable to generate microflow with parameter of type Enumeration.
Fixed Maia generating microflow with incompatible parameter data types.
Fixed Maia context menu options in App Explorer not navigating back to chat when Maia Learn open.
Fixed Maia toolbar button not following Maia preference toggle. Now visible and enabled only when Maia enabled.
Fixed clicking Maia toolbar button not opening Maia panel.
Fixed right-click context menu not showing in Maia panel.
Fixed Maia generating documents with same name or invalid names.
Fixed Maia context menu not disabled after disabling Maia.
Fixed bundling of protected modules in App Modules not including JS Actions and other dependencies.
Fixed Dropdown widget not respecting SafeArea on Android devices OS 13+.
Updated babel-generator to fix known @babel/generator regression.
Fixed Call REST Service activity error when modeling Content-Length header. Can now specify but suppressed if payload has known size or chunked encoding.
Fixed consumed OData service error when retrieving data containing nextLink.
Fixed consumed OData services. Non-integer timeout now results in consistency error.
Fixed incompatible queued task not removed from queue and remaining stuck with Running status.
Fixed synchronization causing scheduled event to execute multiple times.
Fixed Partial clone to Full clone conversion. Mendix Version now displayed in new history panel after conversion.
Fixed issues with MCP authentication.
Fixed Modernized Runtime console table sometimes exceeding row limit and clearing itself.
Fixed URL encoding issues in client-side navigation with special characters in page parameter values.
Fixed popups appearing at bottom of screen instead of centered in React client.
Fixed race condition in React client where focus unexpectedly removed when page finished loading. Autofocus now waits until widgets fully load.
Fixed deleting duplicate navigation profile deleting wrong duplicate profile.
Fixed mxbuild incorrectly reporting modern web client bundler stopped unexpectedly while React client completed normally.
Fixed Oops pop-up when copying button widgets with parameter arguments to page templates/building blocks or creating them from pages with buttons.
Fixed History Web pane timeouts for large repositories and eliminated refresh commit history errors.
DynamicValue types for web file and web image properties deprecated; will remove in Mendix 12. Use allowUpload="true" instead.
Removed deprecated tcpjson log subscriber. tcpsonlines log subscriber still exists.
Oracle database: invalid SQL generated by task queue subsystem causes application startup to fail.
After importing widget-containing modules, subsequent widget module imports silently fail. Restart Studio Pro required.
Microsoft Edge WebView 2 version 150 causes "t is not a function" error in logic editors. New documents created but editor won't open.
Logic Recommender breaks with "t is not a function" error from Microsoft Edge WebView 2 version 150; closed and reopened editor clears error.
Introduced Start with Maia feature to generate apps from text descriptions and optional images/PDFs, including domain model and test data.
Added Maia for Workflows to generate workflows by text and image prompts.
Introduced new message for Maia generation sessions allowing navigation back to related documents or creating new Generate sessions.
Updated filter button in Go to... dialog to show active filters if any.
Logic editors now disable snapping when pressing Shift while dragging objects from App Explorer, Toolbox or toolbar.
Released workflow interrupting boundary events for general availability allowing workflows to interrupt flows when timers expire and start alternate flows.
Added recurrence support on non-interrupting boundary events with configurable initial execution time, recurrence count, and interval from minutes to months.
Feature to access online data in offline apps is now generally available.
Introduced OQL Query interface, a user-friendly feature representing view entities for defining and managing OQL queries.
Enabled native mobile builds for PMP customers.
To open and convert apps in Mendix 11.0.0 and above, apps must be Mendix version 10.21.0 or above.
Back and Forward mouse buttons now navigate through history of active editors in Studio Pro.
Added support for retrieving CSRF token using new client API getCSRFToken from mx-api/session for calling secured REST services.
Added selector in Edit view entity dialog to specify user for live preview, enabling preview of queries using [%CurrentUser%] token.
React client is now set as the default client when creating new applications in Studio Pro.
Enabled OpenAPI Documentation pane for Published REST services to assist building REST services by previewing resulting OpenAPI document.
External Database Connector now supports executing anonymous blocks on databases that allow this feature.
Added mx tool capability to view and delete private values Studio Pro has stored in local app data.
Added CLI command to mx.exe to export Security Overview to JSON and XLSX formats with optional marketplace exclusion and custom output file.
Added Contact Support option in Help > Support Tools menu to reach Mendix support website directly from Studio Pro.
Enabled history navigation using arrow keys by default and moved navigation settings to Work Environment tab.
Apps opening in Studio Pro now automatically convert to MPRV2 storage format. MPRv1 apps over 250MB require conversion to commit.
Changed port fix terminology to cherry pick aligning with Git and added recognition of cherry pick and revert operations to top bar.
Introduced OQL Query interface with integrated Maia for OQL AI feature for easier writing, preview, and maintenance of OQL queries.
Introduced new API for showing modal dialogs from web extensions under studioPro.ui.dialogs.
Introduced feature allowing users to add app folder to Microsoft Defender exclusions list.
Introduced new API for accessing user preferences from web extensions including theme (light/dark) and language settings under studioPro.ui.preferences.
Introduced new API for showing notification popups from web extensions under studioPro.ui.notifications.
Now import only one content-type header from OpenAPI contract in Consumed REST service. Feature is in Beta.
Improved validation of default value for AutoNumber attribute in Studio Pro to allow values larger than 2,147,483,647.
Page not found dialog text is now translatable.
Improved performance of workflow versioning conflict analysis for workflows with many nested outcome-based activities.
Added error logging when a page fails to be loaded in React client when navigating to it, e.g., widget with corrupted bundle.
Moved all Maia-related preferences from New Features tab to Maia tab under new Generative AI section.
Improved startup performance of task queues by validating pending tasks at execution instead of startup.
Added OQL keywords: DELETE, INSERT, REPLACE, UPDATE, UPSERT, INTO, SET, VALUES, IGNORE, MATCHED, DUPLICATE, KEY, CONFLICT, MERGE, USING, SOURCE, TARGET, WITH. Cannot be used unquoted as identifiers.
Integrated modernized access rules editor into entity Properties pane.
Modernized App Explorer now keeps currently active document selected when Keep active document selected preference enabled.
Studio Pro now downloads current sprint data only when Stories view gets opened.
Added support for Brazilian Portuguese to Studio Pro.
Improved messages shown when running OQL query in view entities, including clearer messages for app startup and [%CurrentUser%] references.
Relaxed restriction: entities with online sync can now refer to offline sync entities, but XPath constraints in pages/nanoflows still cannot mix them.
When tracing enabled, traces now include spans for all Microflow activities.
Bundled OpenTelemetry agent jar with Studio Pro at runtime/agents/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar.
Provided Enable Tracing option for runtime tracing in Studio Pro via App Settings.
No longer close response writer of custom request handlers if asynchronous request is started, enabling async request handlers.
Implemented OpenTelemetry agent extension providing default settings at runtime/agents/mendix-opentelemetry-agent-extension.jar.
Added consistency warnings if multiple versions of same Java dependency exist in app.
Changed OData HTTP 422 reason phrase to Unprocessable Content per RFC 9110.
Prevent package from unpacking content to undesired directories when importing module, widget, solution package or starting app from template.
Now highlight access rule opened from Changes or Error pane in modernized entity access rules editor instead of directly opening it.
Improved Java API for CSP implementation with getHeader, getCustomHeaders, getTemplate, getNonce, hasNonce, addHeader methods.
Improved error reporting for React client to show JS actions and widget errors directly in Studio Pro.
Aligned preview values of page and snippet variables between structure and design mode.
Made it easier to use widget action variables when configuring parameter mappings for Call a Microflow and Call a Nanoflow actions.
Changed default Role Type in Accessibility section from Link Button to Link for correct functionality.
In Consumed REST Service, define body content as Create Entity (JSON), Use as template with parameters in curly braces.
Added progress indicator to Create entity button in response and body structure of Consumed REST service document.
Added new entity WorkflowEndedUserTask to System module, saves data when workflow user task ends.
Extended FeedbackHelper.OpenFormFeedback Java API to allow opening pages with multiple parameters.
Data views no longer needed for page parameters with input elements, pluggable widget attribute properties, and snippet calls.
Added transparency to disabled toolbar button icons for better visibility.
Updated dotnet runtime version installed with Studio Pro.
Studio Pro now shows notification in top-right corner instead of error pop-up for unhandled exceptions.
Made Studio Pro start faster and consume less memory by improving efficiency of Starter app template image handling.
Added support for dark mode to Create New App page.
Improved OpenAPI Documentation pane layout with more compact design for easier operation viewing.
OpenAPI document of published OData services now uses OpenAPI version 3.0.4 instead of 3.0.1.
Maia for pages now works with existing pages, understanding content to add, change, or remove widgets.
Introduced category to design properties, allowing optional grouping within styling pane.
Upgraded Micrometer Prometheus registry dependency.
Added com.mendix.core.conf.LicenseInfo#validateCustomerID(String) method to check customer identity match.
Added option to add extra arguments to Gradle process in Studio Pro Preferences.
Added extra-gradle-arguments option to MxBuild to pass extra arguments to Gradle process.
Pushing commits to server is no longer possible if there is nothing to push.

affected: entity and member access rights validation
text: Improved entity and member access rights validation in modernized Entity Access Rules editor.
Improved warning pop-up when converting nanoflows: renamed Find Usages to Show Usages, shows only irreplaceable usages.
Modernized Entity Access Rules editor now supports viewing access rules for non-editable System entities.
Upgraded JDBC driver for Microsoft SQL Server to version 12.10.0, may require updating in userlib.
Improved check/uncheck behavior of Open API request selection dialog for Consumed REST Service.
Variables of pages and snippets are now available in XPath constraints.
OQL queries now support NULL in CAST expressions to cast empty values to DATETIME, DECIMAL, INTEGER, LONG, STRING.
Improved live preview of view entities: columns with associations show entity name in header, empty cell when no associated object.
Can now copy from Run Query table in view entities in Studio Pro.
Now highlight loop border when dragging elements inside of it.
Made connection points and resize handles only visible on selected element, hold Shift to display on hover.
Moved connected elements out of way when element is resized.
When inserting elements with annotation into flow, make room based only on length of inserted elements.
Making element smaller automatically repositions connected elements to preserve width between them.
When inserting elements into flow, connected and unconnected elements in container are moved to make space.
Updated react-native-reanimated to latest version.
Updated @react-navigation to latest version.
mx create-module-package command now synchronizes and includes managed dependencies of module in exported package.
Added exclude-managed-dependencies flag to disable managed dependencies inclusion in module package.
Authentication token is now rotated, generating new token upon session expiration for improved security.
Inherited attributes and associations from entity generalization now marked with distinct inherited icon.
Navigation menu buttons are now reachable when they are visible.
Navigation tree menu is no longer tagged with aria-hidden when it is still visible.
Added aria-expanded, aria-haspopup and aria-controls attributes to navigation tree where relevant.
Made it easier to use variables for pages and snippets in conditional visibility, editability, and text templates.
Connector pane now features page and snippet variables.
Improved SQL parsing in External Database Connector to correctly ignore parameters inside comments.
Improved context menu in page and microflow editors to support navigation using arrow keys.
