Fixed the Changes pane focusing a document that was being brought back to focus after each project save.

Fixed a decision's custom error handler being skipped when its expression or rule failed after another decision had run in the same microflow; a No connecting flow found error went to the calling microflow instead.
Fixed the known issue where web applications deployed with the Rspack bundler broke when the deployment package was made on Windows or run on Studio Pro on Windows.
Fixed the known issue where REST, OData, Web Services and all other features using client certificate authentication did not send the client certificate.
Fixed a Custom Chart in a pop-up window spamming the console with type errors when users hovered over data points.
Fixed signing out of native and offline-first web apps showing a database error when other database operations were still running.
Fixed offline synchronization operation IDs changing between builds, causing synchronization errors after updating a native app.
Fixed comparing two lists with = in a client-evaluated expression using a membership check instead of true equality; [1, 2] = [2, 1] now evaluates to false, matching microflow behavior.
Fixed apps using the React client calling the wrong nanoflow at runtime when multiple modules contained nanoflows with the same name.
Fixed a crash when launching the Native App Builder UI (NBUI) a second time while a previous instance was still being tracked.
Added Best Practice Recommender rules that help limit anonymous user access; several can apply changes automatically.
Improved Studio Pro performance, especially for App Explorer operations such as right-click and double-click to open.
Improved the app bundle error dialog to show clearer error messages and the location of the full app bundle log.
Fixed files bigger than 5MB not being downloadable when encryption was enabled for S3.
Fixed clearing the selection with a JavaScript action not working for data widgets with Keep selection enabled, such as Data Grid 2; previously selected rows became selected again.
Fixed an app crashing on start-up when a different user logged in after a previous session, due to a discrepancy between the offline database and session.
Fixed a performance issue when filtering over an association with multiple selected values, for example with a drop-down filter on a Data Grid 2.
The file download API now returns 404 Not Found instead of an exception-based error code.
New custom setting HttpClient.ValidateAfterInactivityMs enables connection validation before reuse.
Upgraded the JDBC driver for SAP HANA to version 2.29.11.
Fixed excluded Jar files not being respected by Eclipse.
Fixed Strict Mode not working correctly with certain Client APIs and nanoflow actions in offline apps.
Fixed Call REST Service with Apply import mapping and a mismatched parameter type; it now shows consistency error CE0245 instead of an error message.
Increased the number of initial commits loaded when selecting a revision for revert, cherry-pick and deploy from 25 to 250, because some commits could be omitted.
Fixed pasting into a form, workflow or domain model throwing an error when the clipboard content no longer matched what was expected.
Fixed the constant dialog not updating the input field after changing the constant data type.
Fixed a pop-up warning when adding a new business event document while the extension module was not available in the app.
Fixed Java sources of protected modules being added to the Eclipse build path.
Fixed source maps being generated for production builds when the Optimize bundle option was disabled.
Fixed onChange client actions for attribute and association widget properties where associated objects passed as arguments to an action were always empty.

Web applications deployed with the Rspack bundler are broken when packaged or run on Windows; macOS, public cloud and Linux on-premises are unaffected. Workaround: switch to Rollup for local Windows development.
REST, OData, Web Services and all other features using client certificate authentication fail because the client certificate is not sent. Do not upgrade to this version; upgrade to 10.24.28.
In apps using the React client, generated sources are now placed in deployment/websource, so deployment/web only contains files served to the browser.
Fixed auto-committed entries and objects not being cleaned up after an app restart.
Fixed a caching issue causing errors in React client PWAs after deploying a new version; page requests now include a cache-busting query parameter.

Fixed an app not opening when a Send REST request used a consumed REST query parameter with dots in its name (for example Person.Address.Zipcode); the runtime now sends the full name, not the part after the last dot.
Warnings about unknown configuration settings now show only the setting name.
Fixed files from external entities published via OData not being downloadable.
Fixed renaming a document making Studio Pro unresponsive for 30 seconds and then failing with a timeout error while the Changes pane was open.
Fixed the Changes pane focusing a document that was being brought back to focus after each save of the app.
Fixed an excluded JavaScript action not being openable in the JavaScript action editor.

XSD imports no longer fetch nested schemas from private or local network addresses, follow redirects only to public addresses. Workaround: save schema references next to the root XSD, point schemaLocation and import from your computer.
The Maia Chat pane may appear and remain functional even when Maia is disabled in Edit > Preferences. Workaround: manually close the panel.

Switching from BYO LLM back to the Mendix Platform provider and saving causes reasoning and caching to stop functioning. Workaround: click New Chat to restore them (only available when the chat is not empty).

Added support for updating a module from a file for module packages created before Mendix 11.12.0; Studio Pro maps documents by name, then runs the merge algorithm and conflict resolution so module customizations can be kept.
Added a new API (studioPro.ai.chat) to prefill the Maia chat window with input text and either let the user review it before sending or send it automatically.
Added Best Practice Recommender rules that help limit anonymous user access; several can apply changes automatically.
Maia now supports prompt caching and reasoning when connected to your own Amazon Bedrock models.
Added a confirmation dialog box before publishing so you can review and confirm the action.
Runtime now exits with exit code 7 instead of 0 when a cluster node misses its heartbeat, so service managers can restart it as a failure; the heartbeat check ignores system clock changes.
Improved Studio Pro MCP Server connection handling; MCP clients such as Claude Code connected to Studio Pro must be disconnected and reconnected after updating.
Fixed the known issue where storage GUIDs were not retained during module update from an .mpk file.
Fixed a race condition that occurred during metadata update.
Fixed date filters sent to OData services with DateTimeOffset attributes using the wrong date format, causing the remote service to reject the request.
Fixed the analyze-mpr command of mx.exe crashing on projects containing modules with more than 10,000 documents.
Fixed metadata being missed during a commit with a large number of model changes.
Fixed tab labels being cut off on mobile apps depending on the combination of styling and alphanumeric characters.
Fixed a client error dialog when sorting or filtering on microflow, nanoflow or association data sources by an attribute or association the user could not access due to access rule constraints.
Fixed a row extracted with Extract to new grid not being selectable in the page editor, lacking Insert row above/below options, and being inserted at the wrong position or causing an error.

Fixed offline synchronization operation IDs changing between builds, which could cause synchronization errors after updating a native app.
Fixed missing file content on the server causing a microflow's Sync to device action to fail in offline apps instead of skipping the affected objects and synchronizing the rest.
Fixed Prometheus failing to scrape the /prometheus endpoint on the admin port because the response had no Content-Type header and Prometheus could not parse the jvm_info metric.

Fixed app deployment failing while exporting a nanoflow when a Call JavaScript action with Use return value turned off still had an old output variable name that matched another variable in the nanoflow.
Fixed an error in Studio Pro when deleting a nanoflow variable referenced by a Synchronize specific objects activity.
Fixed an index.lock error when performing a rebase.
Fixed consistency errors not showing up after changing security settings.

Fixed entity access rules containing invalid module role references after copying or moving an entity to another module, preventing role selection and updates in the access rule editor.
Fixed dragging a toolbar item in the logic editors not working the first time after dragging a different one.
Fixed Maia page generation removing all but one translation from a page title in apps with multiple languages; page titles now keep all translations.
Fixed Maia page generation removing design properties of widgets nested inside a custom widget, such as containers in a Data Grid 2 column filter; these are now kept.

Fixed Maia tool outputs appearing empty or truncated on both the Mendix platform and Amazon Bedrock models.

Fixed migrating an application generating incorrect association aliases in a View Entity OQL when associations were defined using the OQL COALESCE function, causing duplicate column names and validation errors.
Fixed retrieving objects in offline apps failing with a SQLite No such column error when an XPath constraint traversed an association to a referenced entity with specializations.

Fixed the diff of values not being shown correctly during a merge conflict.
Fixed a crash when selecting a branch in the App Selector in Studio Pro when Mendix version information was missing from a branch.
Fixed documents created by the user incorrectly appearing in the Maia changes list.

The new module update flow (right-click a module, Update from file) does not restore StorageGuids and StableGuids for native mobile, causing data loss when the app starts; the usual import module flow is unaffected.

The Changes pane now shows changes made by Maia, including changed elements and properties inside documents; starting a commit now triggers the keep all action for documents generated by Maia.
Maia can now create Import Mapping and Export Mapping documents using JSON Structures as a source and auto-map to new entities; changing existing mappings is not supported yet.
Maia now supports creating and editing Java action documents and Java action source code files.
Maia can now create and edit External Database Connection documents.
You can now attach more file types (CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, HTML and Excel) to Maia chat messages; attached files stay available to Maia for the rest of the session.
Maia can now delete documents in your app, asking for permission first; a deletion cannot be undone.
Maia now supports Plan Mode, which creates an implementation plan from your prompt that you can review and refine before implementation begins.
Studio Pro now includes Playwright, and Maia uses it to check the running app in its Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle.

Configuring a custom AI provider is released for general availability (GA).

Added a new user authentication API (studioPro.ui.userAuthentication) to check the signed-in state (isSignedIn), retrieve the user's profile (getUserProfile) and subscribe to signedIn/signedOut events.
The History pane now shows a loading indicator next to the search box while background search results are still loading.
Added a pre-check to the commit process that checks app integrity to avoid committing a corrupted app with missing mx unit files.
You can now open historical versions of domain models directly from the comparison pane.
You can now open historical versions of microflows, nanoflows and workflows directly from the comparison pane.
Added a Tool Call Permissions settings page to view and manage all tool permissions, including MCP tools and web fetch permissions, set to always allow or allow only in the current session.
Design mode now reacts to document exclusions, inclusions, deletions and additions in an app.

Introduced an overview listing all modules in your app (App > Tools > Module Overview) from which you can update Marketplace modules by providing an MPK file; a future update will connect it to the Marketplace.
Added a Setup folder to modules so publishers can reference documents there and highlight them for consumers.

Improved the JavaScript action editor with project-aware language support: it understands other JavaScript files in the app, provides Mendix Client API type information, automatic imports and IntelliSense for installed npm packages.

Workflow groups can be managed at runtime (App Settings > Workflow > Group definition = Runtime); groups are then not synchronized from the model, XPath constraints should use the Name attribute instead of group tokens (quick fix available).
The Text Area widget no longer uses inline styling for Grow Automatically; this requires upgrading the Atlas Core module to version 3.21.1 or 4.5.1, depending on which version your app uses.

Upgraded the JDBC driver for Microsoft SQL Server to version 13.6.1; if you connect with integrated security in a module such as Database Connector, you may need to update the JDBC driver in userlib as well.
Added a confirmation dialog box before publishing so you can review and confirm the action.
Added a Kafka tab to the runtime settings in Studio Pro to configure Kafka settings for Change Data Capture event publishing.
Change Data Capture documents now show the ID attribute for each exposed entity, including its exposed name.
Added tooltips to the Change Data Capture document explaining disabled items, pending changes and modification states.
The Change Data Capture document now shows attributes and associations in the same order as the domain model, with deleted items at the bottom.
Improved Change Data Capture event publishing performance by sending events in batches and updating the Kafka Producer configuration.
Added support for custom Kafka SASL properties in the runtime configuration for Change Data Capture event publishing.
Maia now combines multiple thinking blocks to reduce vertical clutter.
Improved the published REST service editor with a tree view of resources and operations and fewer pop-up windows; a toggle under New Features reverts to the old behavior.

Studio Pro now warns when exporting a module that contains files with disallowed paths, since importing such a package is not possible.
Maia now recovers from its own formatting mistakes when calling a tool instead of spending an extra attempt, making single-document creation faster.
The modernized App Explorer is now the default for all users; you can fall back to the legacy App Explorer by disabling the modernized App Explorer flag in Preferences > New Features.
The modernized Find Results pane now shows an overflow button next to the result set tab bar that lists all result sets, marks the active one and scrolls a selected one into view.
